claim: The Artifact JSON hash did not bind the actual files delivered by a working-tree change.
evidence: Artifact wrapper stayed valid when listed source files changed.
Git revision and file hashes were absent.
impact: Reviewed code and released code could differ under one Artifact version.
required_action: Record a Git revision and per-file hashes and verify them with check-records --repo.

prevention.action: working_tree_change Artifacts require source_revision and file_hashes resolved at that revision.
